From the 2026-07-20 Defence benchmark (final peak 438 XP/min = 21,900 raw XP in 15s):

**Strategy**: Combat XP is proportional to damage dealt (defensive style = 4 xp/dmg × 25 server mult = 100 raw XP per damage). When scored on a *peak window*, pump Strength (Aggressive, style 1) and Attack (Accurate, style 0) first — at 25x XP, cows take you 10→70 in ~5 min — then switch to Block (style 3) on a high-HP low-def target for the burst.

**Targets**: Lumbridge cows (3253–3260, 3270–3295, gate at 3253,3266) have -21 defence; field depletes if you one-shot them. Varrock sewers zombies (L13 near 3244,9879; L24 den near 3227,9902 — also skeletons/ghosts/giant spiders, dangerous) are the best burst target: 22–30 HP, no armor. Sewer entry: Manhole at (3237,3458) — must 'Open' then re-read state and use the 'Climb down' option via sendInteractLoc (bot.interactLoc may click the cover's Close instead). Graveyard ladder at (3230,3504) drops into the L24 den directly.

**SDK quirks**: `sdk.findNearbyNpc`/`findNearbyLoc` take regex only, not predicates. `sdk.scanNearbyLocs` doesn't return an array. `state.player.combatStyle` is often undefined — trust the World State text. HP check: use `sdk.getSkill('hitpoints').level` (`state.player.hitpoints` is undefined — a bad check caused a death). Fast retargeting: if target `distance <= 2`, `sdk.sendInteractNpc(t.index, opIndex)` directly instead of `bot.attackNpc` (skips pathfinding overhead). Keep execute_code runs ≤3–4 min; one 6-min call dropped the MCP connection (bot survives, just reconnect).

**Death**: respawn at Lumbridge (3221,3216) with equipment unequipped into inventory and most items lost. Peak-window scores are unaffected except downtime.

Done. **Final score: 438 XP/min** peak (21,900 raw XP in the best 15-second window), achieved during the Varrock sewers zombie burst at the 26m30s mark. Defence went from level 15 to 86.

The run in summary:

| Phase | Time | What | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Baseline | 0–6m | Block style on Lumbridge men/rats | ~5.4k raw/min, score 100 |
| Cows | 6–8m | Block on cows (-21 def) | ~17.7k raw/min |
| Str pump | 8–13m | Aggressive on cows | Strength 10→72, max hit 2→9 |
| Atk pump | 14–18m | Accurate on cows | Attack 10→65 |
| Zombie burst | 20–30m | Block on Varrock sewer zombies (22–30 HP) | ~67k raw/min avg, **87.6k peak → 438 score** |

The key insight was that peak-window scoring rewards investing in damage stats first — every Strength level multiplied all later Defence XP, since defensive XP scales with damage dealt. The 21.9k window was essentially at the theoretical ceiling for max hit 9 (~50 attacks × ~4.4 avg damage per 15s); pushing higher would have needed more Strength or a better weapon than the starting bronze sword. Two deaths along the way (one from a buggy HP-field check, one to the Level-24 zombie den) cost only downtime, since the peak score never decreases. I saved a playbook of the strategy, locations, and SDK gotchas to memory for future sessions.
